I am now changing my review to positive as the issues that concerned me before in Valve multiplayer games have been addressed... for now.

Remain vigilant for cheaters and other malicious actors, and have fun while the peace lasts.

text: Before I played Project Zomboid when I was into zombies, Left 4 Dead was all the rage growing up for me and I was too young to play. Likely, it was available for the Xbox 360 for the time, and it features fast-moving zombies and original mutation creatures that used to be human. I guess the first-party Valve games have some sort of Internet fan following that I seek to disassociate with as an Internet skeptic, but here I am reviewing a genuine PC game by a good developer (Valve) while avoiding the trolls, haters, and jocks of Steam. This game was not the first about zombies: Alone in the Dark, Resident Evil and House of the Dead were prior video games that tackled the genre. However, what it does make up for is that it makes a worthy flagship title for Steam in general with its action, atmosphere, and accessability as a computer game. Enemies like the Hunter, Smoker, and Witch are what really drive the whole software by numbers. I just don't want to associate myself with the users on Steam who troll, post memes, and attack their own kind...but that's just how I feel. All you know need to know is that this game is genuine as an original Steam game.
label: negative

text:
This game is one of my all-time favorite games for multiple reasons. 
It's fun all around, you can come back to this game years later and still have fun, plus you can even download maps.
Id say if you play with friends you will have a real swell time, even sometimes playing with randoms can be fun. I have met lots of nice people surprisingly enough on here.

For better or worse this game will always be a game I hold dear to me. I remember playing this game so much with my cousins on Expert on the 360 days and on PC as well. Sadly things aren't what they used to be but because of a game like this I'll cherish the memories I had because, in the end, that's all I'll really have are the memories. Heck, if I could go back in time to relive the moments of playing this game with them I would time and time again.

At this point, it's better to just get L4D2 since that has 1-2  in it and it's easier to download maps. Plus the more people who get that game and still play it will keep it alive.

The only negative thing, I have to say about this game is the griefers. It's not fun having someone join your game randomly and kill you for no real reason. This game came out in 2009 and with only about 500 people on this game you still have people who still do this and it makes zero sense, at this point, you might as well question their sanity. Eventually, there will be zero people who play this game and the only thing left a griefer will have is grief itself, eventually you can grief all you want but in the end, you are left with it.

Sadly all you can really do is vote to kick them but the reality is they should just get banned from the game even if its only for several weeks, just let people enjoy the game and play the story and have fun with randoms.
label: positive
